meta.title: About Amiya_desi | Indie Developer & Creator
meta.description: Meet indie developer Amiya_desi: DelayTrace and other Godot work, web tools, and notes. See direction and contact links.

letter.title: Hi, I'm Amiya_desi
letter.intro: I'm Amiya_desi, an indie developer and student with games as my main creative line. A recent highlight is DelayTrace. I explore time mechanics, multi-window interaction, and narrative puzzles, and I also build websites and tools while sharing what I learn.

sections.heading: Creative practice
paragraphs: Indie game development: I mainly use Godot and GDScript, with some C# experience. Small games, game jams, and longer projects help me practice mechanics, implementation, and iteration.
Websites and tools: I build personal sites and browser tools. Public utilities like GeoScore are optional side tools—not the main line.
Self-hosting: I use Docker, VPSs, and Cloudflare to deploy and maintain personal services, and keep the lessons public.
Content and workflows: I write articles, make videos, curate resources, and use tools like n8n to organize and share them—leaving more time for making things and talking with people.

sections.heading: Projects and milestones
sections.intro: These projects represent different stages of my work. Each project page has the latest status.

items.text: DelayTrace: A Godot game about time delay, recorded actions, and replay. It was one of my favorite recent game-jam projects and has a playable public build.
WakeUpAtTheBorder: A Godot game combining puzzles, dialogue, and combat. It won second place in the themed track of GodotHub's third Jam; see the project page and winner list for details.
TimeRewindLinker: A puzzle experiment built around rewinding time, replaying actions, and connecting the player with echoes of the past.
Enhanced Save System: A modular Godot save plugin with GDScript and C# implementations.
GeoScore: A public-web SEO/GEO side tool with a free quota; fuller reports can use a one-time Site Pass.
Mio's Window Wanderer: A multi-window narrative prototype I helped create, exploring window navigation and dialogue.

sections.heading: Current direction
paragraphs: My main goal is to finish and publish my first Steam game.

I want to carry what I learn from small experiments into a more complete project while continuing to practice implementation, debugging, and judgment. Websites, tools, and public notes will follow the real projects and interests that come with that work.

sections.heading: Find me and stay in touch
paragraphs: I usually go by Amiya_desi, and my GitHub username is Amiyadesi.

items.text: Blog: development notes, learning notes, tutorials, and retrospectives.
GitHub: public code and open-source projects
itch.io: small games, game-jam projects, and gameplay experiments.
Bilibili: videos, game projects, and tinkering notes.
Guestbook: suggestions, questions, or just a hello.
Support: help keep development and maintenance going.

signature.ps: P.S. If anything in this letter resonates with you, feel free to leave a note in the guestbook.

items.question: What is sayori.org
items.answer: It's the personal site of Amiya_desi, featuring games such as DelayTrace, development notes, optional public tools, and contact links.

items.question: What does the blog cover
items.answer: blog.sayori.org covers Godot development, websites and self-hosting, AI workflows, tools and resources, project retrospectives, and creative learning.

items.question: What is your current main goal
items.answer: My main goal is to finish and publish my first Steam game. Other experiments, web tools, and articles will grow alongside real projects and learning.

items.question: How can I contact you or learn more
items.answer: Use me@sayori.org, or visit GitHub, the blog, itch.io, Bilibili, or the guestbook.
